propositions: Amd64 Jira DC harness boots only in CI; arm64 hosts stall under emulation, making live-only defect root-causing prohibitively slow (2h push-to-CI cycle)

An agentic investigator probe runs multiple live reconciliation experiments against a single ephemeral DC boot using rebar's own primitives (run_python, jira_rest tools) to root-cause rich-text storage defects without code changes to src/rebar

The opt-in pytest module test_dc_richtext_agentic_probe.py reuses existing bound_dc_issue fixtures and produces a structured RichTextRca finding with cited experiment evidence, skipping cleanly when env opt-in is unset

Workflow jira-dc-richtext-probe.yml is workflow_dispatch-only with throwaway ephemeral DC, REBAR_MCP_READONLY=1, required ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, and artifacts uploaded containing RichTextRca contract and evidence
The investigator runs against any reachable live DC (local make jira-dc-up or CI) via same pytest invocation, inert on ordinary runs and never triggered on push/PR/schedule
Verified execution on main produced RichTextRca finding with 10 experiments citing 20 evidence ids across 51 entries in both tool kinds (run_python, jira_rest)
